author: IcyCode
body:
Personally I think we should have waiting lobbies back again for between games of the following gamemodes:
  • Survival games
  • CTH
  • Nexus
  • Arcade
  • Hunger Games
Also during the waiting periods between each game we have access to the ender chest gadgets as seen in the beta testing. Just a way to make credits and gadgets more popular and visible.

Also during the waiting period you can vote for the next map (like on MCZone SG) buy clicking on a villager in the waiting lobby.
Just an idea guys, leave comments & criticism below!

replies.body: No, please god no. I hate those, I don't play on servers with that for that very reason. It sucks, and lets say there is a game where when you die, you are dead for good.
